allowed_outcome: Independent scratch-only probe and report; no PageRouter source/Git changes.
finding: The proposed loss-of-registration-draft hypothesis is falsified by the current app/controller path: the mounted app source binds bubbled input events to updateDraft, and updateDraft stores registration name/email/phone before submission. On a mismatch, localValidation returns before identity assignment, but identity already contains the input draft; renderPublicSite consumes those same identity fields.

probe.kind: controller-plus-renderer fixture probe; not an actual mounted browser run

scenarios.name: mismatch
scenarios.outcome: The password confirmation does not match.

scenarios.name: missing-terms
scenarios.outcome: Read and accept the preview terms before registering.

scenarios.name: valid
scenarios.renderer_projection: registration status is pending; the registration renderer selects its pending-request page

probe.credentials: Passwords and confirmations were generated per iteration in memory and not emitted or persisted.

source_evidence.app_submit_binding: PageRouter/checkpoint/vendor/hh/src/app.mjs:179-197; FormData is dispatched to public:register after required-field validity; passwords are cleared from DOM before dispatch.
source_evidence.validation_order: PageRouter/checkpoint/vendor/hh/src/public-controller.mjs:697-715; mismatch and missing-terms validation precede the registration.identity assignment.
source_evidence.draft_fields: PageRouter/checkpoint/vendor/hh/src/public-controller.mjs:872-879; password-like names are rejected; registration name/email/phone are copied into identity.

limitations: Actual mounted browser DOM interaction was not observed: local Playwright browser binary is absent; the connected Browser extension context was unavailable; the CUA cloud browser could not reach the localhost preview (ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED).
The host input-to-updateDraft association is source-inspected, not end-to-end browser-verified. The scratch controller/renderer probe does not itself dispatch browser input events.
No screenshot, visual QA, production/backend behavior, real account data, or live service behavior is claimed.
